dedupe_keys.name: images des feux de circulation ferroviaire en france

description: Images des feux de circulation ferroviaire en France is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données produit par l’Institut de Recherche Technologique (IRT) SystemX recense plus de 100 000 images réelles illustrant les 6 types de feux de circulation ferroviaires français avec leurs combinaisons de couleurs (13 états possibles) et leurs 19 signaux différents. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Digital et innovation. Its keywords are SystemX, Feux de circulation ferroviaire. The portal shows 2020-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
